title: Technical Business Analyst - $100,000 - $115,000
text: Technical Business Analyst - $100,000 - $115,000 at Talentpool Recruitment (Melbourne, Bayside & South Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Our client is a leader in the e-commerce space in Australia. They have grown significantly over the past 12 months and will do so again this year. They are a company that always looks to improve in all areas of their work. They have an excellent culture, built on collaboration and flexibility. They are looking for a Technical Business Analyst to join their team on a permanent basis. The ideal candidate will have the following profile: - A background in software engineering or QA is essential - Experience writing SQL queries and working with API Data structures is important - 3 + years as a technical Business Analyst working in product teams - Experience in e-commerce is strongly desired but is not a must-have skill - Strong in stakeholder engagement - Excellent communication and presentation skills If this sounds like your next opportunity, please apply!
